core_categories: Medical Devices; Surgical Products; Custom Kitting; Procedure Trays; Newborn Care; Infusion Systems
specialty_focus: Canadian Hospital Specialties (CHS) is a manufacturer, marketer, and specialty distributor of disposable medical and surgical products for the Canadian hospital market. It produces its own lines under the MED-RX brand and partners with global medical device principals to supply hospitals and healthcare facilities. CHS distributes newborn care, hearing screening, vascular access, infusion, and pharmacy safety products, and does not appear to focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: MED-RX, Natus Sensory, Spectrum Vascular, AngioDynamics, Eitan Group, Sapphire, International Medical Industries, Velmed, Fresenius Kabi, PriMed Instruments, others
